battle.name: 唐滅焉耆之戰
battle.theater: 天山南麓焉耆盆地與交河通道
battle.brief: 貞觀十八年（644）秋，焉耆與車師同時起兵，與西突厥呼應，切斷西州屯田與驛道。唐以安西都護府兵出關，沿天山南麓南下，攻破焉耆城，追潰兵至西突厥境，重設鎮編羈縻州。卡面科林斯青銅盔屬公元前七世紀，與唐軍無涉；「全正面開眼、只能靠隊形活」正對應本役勝負手：城破在器械，守疆在據點。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 交戰的雙方並非對等的國家，而是帝國秩序與綠洲城邦聯盟之間的落差。唐一方由中書省與兵部議定方略，太宗李世民下詔開戰，出兵主力為安西都護府本部兵與各道調集的募兵、府兵，輔以歸附的突厥、鐵勒及西域諸國騎兵；作戰由西州（今吐魯番）的安西都護府統一指揮，都護府下設校尉、兵曹參軍、錄事參軍、倉曹參軍等職，兼管羈縻州縣的戶口、賦稅與屯田。焉耆一方是鐵建城東南的綠洲王國，都城員渠，周境約三千餘里、二十餘城；國王受唐封為郡王，國中同時存在王的直屬部眾與遊牧部落，兵力以城兵與騎兵為主，兩者作戰方式不同，城兵守城，騎兵遊擊。與焉耆同時起兵的還有車師國，控制交河（今吐魯番）一帶的絲路北道要衝，國土與焉耆相鄰，兩國可以互相接應。背後支援叛軍的是西突厥汗庭，其遊牧騎兵在草原上可以迅速集結與轉移，是唐廷無法用一次攻擊解決的對手。中原王朝在西域沒有可供長期駐紮的大軍，只能靠都護府這樣的派出機構與羈縻體系維持存在。
countriesEn: Neither side here was a match of equals; the contest was between an imperial order and a coalition of oasis city-states. On the Tang side, policy was settled in the Secretariat and the Ministry of War, and Emperor Taizong (Li Shimin) issued the order to fight. The main body of the army was the garrison of the Protectorate General to Pacify the West together with recruited soldiers and imperial levies (fubing) sent out by the circuits, supported by Turkic, Tiele and other Western Regions horsemen who had already submitted. Operations were directed from Xizhou (modern Turpan), where the protectorate's staff included a xiaowei, a bingcao canjun, a lushi canjun and a cangcao canjun, and where the household registers, taxes and military farms of the jimi prefectures and counties were administered. Yanqi was an oasis kingdom lying to the southeast of the Iron-Built city; its capital at Yuanqu was ringed by some twenty-odd towns spread over roughly three thousand li of country. Its king held a Tang princely title, and within the state stood both the king's own retainers and the nomadic tribes of the pastures. Its armed force combined the garrison of the capital and the mounted bands, which fought in different ways: the garrison fought from the walls, the horsemen struck from the saddle. Rising at the same time as Yanqi was the realm of Cheshi, which held the northern branch of the Silk Road around Jiaohe (modern Turpan); it bordered Yanqi closely enough that the two states could support one another. Behind the insurgents stood the khaganate of the Western Turks, whose nomadic cavalry could concentrate and shift faster than any army the Tang could send and which no single blow could eliminate. The Middle Kingdom had no large force it could keep in the west; the empire's presence there rested entirely on detached agencies such as the protectorate and on the jimi system of indirect rule.
people: 關鍵人物分三類。第一類是決策者唐太宗李世民。焉耆與車師舉兵的消息傳到長安時，朝廷面前有兩條路：一是放棄西域、撤回關內，二是保住這兩個綠洲。太宗選了第二條，詔令出兵，而且不許退兵了事，要求把叛軍追到西突厥一帶才算收束；此後安西都護府改為常駐兵員，焉耆也成為唐在西域的前哨之一。第二類是前人兵部尚書侯君集。貞觀十四年（640）高昌之役，他以交河道行軍大總管的身份率軍出關，造巢車、雲梯攻交河城，再進兵高昌擒其王麴智盛，設西州與安西都護府；幾年後他因太子案被誅，但西征留下的器具、屯田與制度並未一併消失，本次平定焉耆的攻城辦法與屯田辦法，正是那一套的延續。第三類是身處邊地、替唐朝作戰的草原出身將領，以阿史那社爾最為突出，他以昆陵道行軍大總管的身份在貞觀二十二年（648）統軍平龜茲，說明唐朝在西域能打，靠的不只是關中府兵。對面三人則在傳記中只剩名號與結局：焉耆王、車師王，以及在後方提供支持的西突厥汗。焉耆王的姓名在傳抄中說法不一，本篇只以「焉耆王」稱之；據傳記，他兵敗後西走投奔龜茲方向，其後下落只有零星記載。車師王起兵之後仍保住交河一帶，之後十餘年唐與西突厥在車師反覆爭奪，他很可能在這場持久角力中被西突厥一方逐步擠走。至於安西都護府中的校尉、兵曹，以及各羈縻州的都督、刺史，是維持局面的人，但他們的名字大多沒有留下來。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into three groups. The first is the decision maker, Emperor Taizong of Tang (Li Shimin). When the news of the rising at Yanqi and Cheshi reached the capital, two courses lay open: abandon the Western Regions and withdraw inside the passes, or hold on to these two oases. Taizong chose the second. He ordered the army out and refused to allow a withdrawal that merely ended the pursuit, requiring the insurgents to be chased as far as the Western Turkic frontier before the business was closed. The Protectorate General to Pacify the West was thereafter converted into a permanently garrisoned institution, and Yanqi became one of the empire's outposts in the west. The second group is his predecessor, Minister of War Hou Junji. In the Gaochang campaign of 640 (Zhenguan 14) he led the army out of the passes as Commander-in-Chief of the Jiaohe route, built siege towers and scaling ladders to assault the walled city of Jiaohe, then advanced on Gaochang and took its king Qu Zhisheng captive, after which Xizhou and the Anxi Protectorate were established. A few years later he was executed over the crown prince's affair, but the tools, the military farms and the institutions left behind by that western expedition did not perish with him; the siege methods and the farm system used to pacify Yanqi were a direct continuation of them. The third group is the steppe-born commanders who fought for the Tang on the frontier, of whom Ashina She'er is the most prominent: as Commander-in-Chief of the Kunling route he led the campaign that took Kucha in 648 (Zhenguan 22), which shows that Tang success in the west did not rest on the levies of Guanzhong alone. On the other side only the names and the fates of three men survive in the transmitted record: the king of Yanqi, the king of Cheshi, and the Western Turkic khagan who backed them from the steppe. The personal name of the Yanqi king is given inconsistently in the transmitted copies, so he is called only the king of Yanqi here; the record says that after his defeat he fled west toward Kucha, and only scattered notices of his later fate survive. The king of Cheshi kept control of the Jiaohe area after the rising, and for more than a decade afterwards Tang and Western Turkic forces fought over Cheshi; he was most likely gradually squeezed out by the Western Turks in that long contest. The men who actually held the line, the xiaowei and bingcao of the protectorate and the dudu and cishi of the jimi prefectures, left almost no names behind them.
kits: 卡面這件科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀末至六世紀初的希臘產物，約650年，早於這場戰役近一千三百年，與唐軍裝備沒有任何直接關係。它的價值在於提供一個對照：全正面開眼、兩側帶長頰板的青銅盔把人臉幾乎完全包住，視野只剩一條橫縫，戴它的人看不見左右，行動時幾乎不能回頭，因此只能靠身旁的同袍與嚴格的隊形活下來。七世紀的天山南北沒有這種青銅盔。唐軍的頭部防護是兜鍪與胄，鐵質或以漆布為裡，鐵騎與重裝步兵才用全罩式面門與護項，草原出身的突厥、吐蕃式裝備則以皮甲、鎧札甲為主；同一道理在當時的西域同樣成立：焉耆與車師的騎兵靠馬鎧與馬鐙在衝鋒中互相遮蔽，攻城步兵靠把盾牌接成長排，把身體交給隊形去承擔。實際用於這場戰役的唐軍裝備包括步弩與單弓、箭矢、槊與陌刀、步盾與拒馬，以及具裝騎兵所用的馬鎧、馬鐙與長槊；攻城方面沿用高昌之役的做法，用巢車與雲梯貼近城牆，以弩箭壓制城頭。焉耆與車師一側則有城防工事、烽燧、射孔與地道，城兵多持弓與短兵器，騎兵用馬槊與弓箭，善夜襲與斷糧。運輸靠橐駝與馬匹，軍糧主要由西州與沿線屯田供給，飲水依靠交河、焉耆一帶著名的井渠系統，戈壁路段的行程因此以旬計算，而不是以日計算。整個體系裡，這件科林斯青銅盔的位置是「很早以前就被丟在戰場的一件裝備」：它提醒人，頭盔保護的是個人，遮蔽才是軍隊的東西。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a Greek product of the late seventh and early sixth centuries BC, around 650, some thirteen centuries earlier than this campaign, and it has no direct connection to the Tang army's equipment. Its value is as a comparison. A fully face-covering bronze helmet with long cheek pieces wraps almost the whole head, leaving only a narrow horizontal slit; the wearer cannot see to left or right and can hardly turn round in action, and can therefore only stay alive through the men at his shoulder and strict order. There was no such bronze helmet in the Tian Shan in the seventh century. The Tang head protection was the doukou and the zhou, iron, or cloth covered with lacquer, and only armoured cavalry and heavy infantry used the fully closed face and neck guard; steppe equipment of the Turkic and Tibetan type relied on leather and lamellar armour. The same principle held on the other side of the line in the Western Regions: the horsemen of Yanqi and Cheshi covered one another at the charge through horse armour and stirrups, while the assault infantry overlapped their shields into a continuous line, entrusting their bodies to the formation to absorb what came. The Tang equipment actually used in this campaign included the stepping crossbow and the single bow, arrows, the mao spear and the modao long sabre, the infantry shield and the caltrop barrier, and for the armoured horse, barding, stirrups and the long spear. For siege work the practice of the Gaochang campaign was followed: siege towers and scaling ladders were brought against the wall and crossbow fire pinned the defenders on the ramparts. The Yanqi and Cheshi side had walls, beacon towers, arrow slits and cellars, their garrison troops carrying bows and short weapons, their horsemen using lances and arrows, skilled at night raids and at cutting supplies. Transport depended on camels and horses, the grain came mainly from the military farms at Xizhou and along the line, and water came from the well-and-channel systems for which Jiaohe and Yanqi were famous; the length of a day's march across the gravel desert was therefore counted in tens of days rather than in single days. Within the whole system, this Corinthian helmet sits as a piece of equipment abandoned on the battlefield long before: it reminds us that a helmet protects the individual, while cover is a property of the army.
tactics: 這場戰役的過程可以分三段。第一段是起事與斷線：焉耆與車師同時舉兵，攻擊安西都護府在西域的據點與屯田，燒掉驛站的存糧與草料，切斷西州與龜茲之間的往來，使唐軍在出關前就失去補給。兩國同時起兵的意義在於配合：焉耆在盆地南緣，車師在交河，兩地相距數百里但同屬天山南麓的通道，車師的騎兵可以切斷道路，焉耆的城兵則能固守待援，兩國之間只需以遊騎往還就能互相支援，不必正面會師。第二段是進軍與攻城：唐軍自西州出發，沿天山南麓西行，先在交河方向掃清車師的據點，再南下盆地合圍焉耆；攻城依高昌之役的辦法，先以巢車、雲梯近牆，步卒以長盾遮蔽接近，再用弩箭壓制城頭，迫使守軍分批上牆消耗。戰役中唐軍沒有等待援軍，而是用騎兵繞到側後，切斷叛軍退往西突厥的通路，讓城內得不到外援，這是西域遠征能否取勝的關鍵。第三段是追擊與收編：城破之後殘部向草原方向潰散，唐軍以輕騎追擊，一路收繳馬匹與器械，直到叛軍散入西突厥一帶；對留在盆地的部眾則不趕盡，以羈縻州的形式重新編組，由鎮兵與屯田守住通道。整體看，這是一次以兵力優勢壓縮戰略空間的戰役，用密集據點與快速機動，取代了大軍深入草原的消耗戰。
tacticsEn: The campaign can be divided into three phases. The first was the rising and the cutting of the line: Yanqi and Cheshi rose together, struck at the protectorate's posts and military farms in the Western Regions, burned the grain and fodder stored at the relay stations and cut the traffic between Xizhou and Kucha, so that the Tang army would lose its supply before it even left the passes. The significance of the two states rising simultaneously lies in their combination: Yanqi lay at the southern rim of the basin and Cheshi at Jiaohe, several hundred li apart but both on the same corridor south of the Tian Shan. Cheshi's horsemen could sever the road while Yanqi's garrison held its walls and waited for help, and the two only needed to exchange scouting parties to support each other; they never had to meet in a set-piece battle. The second phase was the advance and the siege: the army marched out of Xizhou, ran west along the southern foot of the Tian Shan, first cleared the Cheshi positions in the Jiaohe direction and then turned south into the basin to invest Yanqi. The siege followed the Gaochang method: siege towers and scaling ladders were brought up against the wall, infantry approached under the cover of long shields, and crossbow fire pinned the ramparts, forcing the defenders to come up in small groups and be worn down. The Tang army did not wait for reinforcements; it sent the horse round the flank to cut the road by which the insurgents might fall back towards the Western Turks, so that the city would receive no outside help, and this was the decisive condition for success in a distant western expedition. The third phase was pursuit and reorganisation: after the city fell, the broken remnants scattered towards the steppe, the light horse pursued them, capturing horses and equipment on the way until the insurgents dissolved into Western Turkic territory; those who remained in the basin were not hunted down to the last, but re-formed as jimi prefectures, held by a garrison and by military farms so that the corridor stayed open. Viewed whole, this was a campaign that compressed the strategic space by superiority of numbers, substituting dense posts and rapid manoeuvre for an attritional war of deep penetration into the steppe.
data: 時間：貞觀十八年（644）秋，九月前後起事與出兵，至同年冬局面大致平定，前後約兩三個月。地理：焉耆國都城員渠在鐵建城東南約五十里，國境周三千餘里，二十餘城；自西州（吐魯番）至焉耆約千餘里，焉耆至龜茲約六百里，交河至焉耆約八百餘里，戈壁路段一日行程常不足百里。兵力：唐軍主力是安西都護府本部兵與各道調集的募兵、府兵，輔以歸附的突厥與西域騎兵，確切數目沒有留下可信記載；參照貞觀十四年高昌之役的規模（那次出動的人數遠多於本次，且以攻堅為主），可以確定本次遠征是一支精幹而帶著大量攻城器械的隊伍。攻城：巢車與雲梯數量不少，弩與箭的消耗以日計；到貞觀二十二年平龜茲時，唐軍深入天山腹地，跨越大石與雪山，所需時間以月計。編制：安西都護府下設校尉、兵曹參軍、錄事參軍、倉曹參軍等，羈縻州縣另有都督、刺史；其後形成的安西四鎮中，焉耆是其中之一，說明這場戰爭的成果最終被寫進了常設的邊防架構裡。同期：唐廷在西北對薛延陀用兵，在東北籌備高句麗之役，645年高句麗方面的出兵規模被史家估在十萬上下；西域這條線同時開戰，說明貞觀晚期的邊境是幾條戰線並行的。
dataEn: Timing: the rising and the dispatch of the army both fall in the autumn of 644 (Zhenguan 18), around the ninth month, and the situation was broadly settled by the winter of the same year, a matter of some two or three months. Geography: the capital Yuanqu of Yanqi lay about fifty li to the southeast of the Iron-Built city, and the kingdom measured roughly three thousand li across with some twenty-odd towns; from Xizhou (Turpan) to Yanqi was rather more than a thousand li, from Yanqi to Kucha about six hundred li, and from Jiaohe to Yanqi some eight hundred li or more, with a day's march over the gravel often falling short of a hundred li. Troops: the main body was the Anxi Protectorate's own garrison together with recruited soldiers and levies sent out by the circuits, supported by submitted Turkic and other Western Regions horsemen; no reliable figure for the numbers survives. Judging from the scale of the Gaochang campaign of 640, which moved far more men and was fought mainly as a siege, this expedition can be identified as a lean force that brought a large train of siege equipment. Siege: siege towers and scaling ladders were numerous, and the consumption of crossbows and arrows was counted by the day; by the time of the conquest of Kucha in 648 the army was deep in the belly of the Tian Shan, crossing rock and snow, and the time required was counted by the month. Command structure: under the protectorate sat a xiaowei, bingcao canjun, lushi canjun and cangcao canjun, while the jimi prefectures and counties had their own dudu and cishi; among the Anxi Four Garrisons that took shape later, Yanqi was one, which shows that the outcome of this war was eventually written into the standing frontier structure. Contemporaneity: the court was waging war against the Xueyantuo in the northwest and preparing the campaign against Goguryeo in the northeast, the Goguryeo force of 645 being estimated by historians at around a hundred thousand; a war on the western line at the same time shows that the late Zhenguan frontier ran along several fronts at once.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是權力交接：貞觀六年（632）前後，焉耆王遣使請內屬，被封為郡王，國家名義上歸入唐朝的羈縻體系；貞觀十四年（640）高昌平定、安西都護府設於西州之後，唐朝第一次在西域有了常設的軍政機構，焉耆與車師都被編為羈縻州，王仍是本國君主，但受唐廷冊封、受兵臨護、繳納貢賦。中間層是遊牧部眾與綠洲王權的分裂：焉耆王所代表的是城中的王權與依附於王的一部分部眾，但盆地的畜牧部落長期聽命於草原的宗主；西突厥在貞觀初年重新整合汗庭之後，把重新控制天山南北的綠洲當作第一步，既有能力策反城內不滿的部眾，也有理由提供騎兵支援。最深的一層是唐廷邊疆政策本身的代價：安西都護府兵力有限，主要靠屯田自給，駐紮與屯田都要動用當地的草場、水源與人力，與焉耆、車師本地勢力的利益必然衝突；一旦王朝在西方的用兵過於分散，例如與高句麗同時開戰，都護府就難以同時壓住兩個綠洲。貞觀十八年秋，焉耆與車師同時起兵、與西突厥遙相呼應，就是這些矛盾同時爆發的結果。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was a transfer of authority: around 632 (Zhenguan 6) the king of Yanqi sent envoys to ask to come under Tang protection and was made a commandery king, so the state nominally entered the Tang jimi order; after Gaochang was taken in 640 (Zhenguan 14) and the Protectorate General to Pacify the West was set up at Xizhou, the Tang for the first time had a permanent military-administrative body in the Western Regions, and Yanqi and Cheshi were both enrolled as jimi prefectures. The kings remained the rulers of their own states, but now received investiture from the court, stood under Tang supervision and paid tribute. The middle layer was the fracture between nomadic clans and oasis kingship: the king of Yanqi embodied the royal house of the city and the portion of the tribes attached to it, but the pastoral clans of the basin had long obeyed a steppe overlord; after the Western Turkic khaganate was reorganized in the early Zhenguan years, taking the oasis states south of the Tian Shan back under control was its first step, and it both had the means to turn disaffected clans in the cities and every reason to back them with cavalry. The deepest layer was the price of the Tang frontier policy itself: the protectorate's forces were few and fed themselves largely from military farms, and both the garrisoning and the farming drew on local pasture, water and labour, which inevitably collided with the interests of Yanqi's and Cheshi's local power; and whenever the empire spread its western operations too thin, for instance by fighting Goguryeo at the same time, the protectorate could not hold two oases down at once. The simultaneous rising of Yanqi and Cheshi in the autumn of 644, answering the Western Turks from a distance, was the result of all these contradictions bursting at once.
impact: 短期看，這場戰爭換來的是一個前哨。焉耆的城防被修整，鎮兵與屯田落戶，驛道向西接通龜茲與疏勒；貞觀二十二年（648）唐軍平龜茲後，安西都護府的治所與防線西移，焉耆正好在兩者之間，成為天山南麓通道上不可缺少的一環。制度上，這次平叛之後，羈縻州縣、冊封與質子、屯田與驛站三者被綁得更緊；唐廷從此不再把西域看成可以隨時丟掉的地方，657年平西突厥、其後設安西四鎮與北庭都護府，都可以看成一條線的延伸。軍事上更實際的後果是：焉耆與車師的歸附，把西突厥在塔里木盆地東緣的立足點擠到只剩下車師一帶，唐朝在西域的防守從一個孤立的西州變成一條有縱深的線，而這條線繼續西伸，最終把唐朝的影響推到了鹽澤、拔汗那與怛羅斯一帶。對草原上的其他部族來說，焉耆的結果是一個明確的警告：與唐為敵不只是打一場仗，而是要面對一個幾年後還會再來的帝國。代價也清楚：遠征在西域消耗的兵力和糧秣，與645年高句麗之役、其後對薛延陀的用兵同時存在；侯君集在640年高昌之役後被召回京師，戰功帶來的榮譽與猜忌同樣落在參戰者身上，而唐太宗最終選擇的辦法，是用制度和羈縻換取不打仗，而不是用人命換取土地。
impactEn: In the short run, the war bought an outpost. Yanqi's defences were repaired, a garrison and military farms were settled there, and the relay road was carried west to Kucha and Shule; after the army took Kucha in 648 (Zhenguan 22) the seat and the defensive line of the protectorate shifted west, and Yanqi lay exactly between the two, becoming an indispensable link in the corridor south of the Tian Shan. Institutionally, after this suppression the jimi prefectures, investiture and hostages, military farms and relay stations were bound together more tightly; the court no longer treated the Western Regions as a place that could be dropped at will, and the defeat of the Western Turks in 657, the establishment of the Anxi Four Garrisons and later of the Protectorate General to Pacify the North all read as extensions of one line. The more concrete military consequence was this: the submission of Yanqi and Cheshi squeezed the Western Turks' footing on the eastern rim of the Tarim Basin down to Cheshi alone, and Tang defence in the west changed from an isolated Xizhou into a line with depth, a line that kept stretching west and eventually carried Tang influence out to the salt marshes, to Ferghana and to Talas. For the other steppe tribes the outcome at Yanqi carried a clear warning: to be the Tang's enemy was not to fight one battle, but to face an empire that would come back a few years later. The cost is equally plain: the soldiers and grain consumed by the expedition in the west existed alongside the Goguryeo campaign of 645 and the later war against the Xueyantuo; Hou Junji was recalled to the capital after Gaochang in 640, and the renown his victories brought, along with the suspicion they bred, fell on those who had served; and what Taizong finally chose was to buy the absence of further fighting with institutions and jimi rule, not with lives spent for territory.
result: 焉耆的城被攻破，王的抵抗結束。殘部向草原方向潰散，被騎兵追到西突厥一帶才停下，留在盆地的部眾重新編為羈縻州，由鎮兵與屯田看著；安西都護府在焉耆設鎮，與後來的龜茲、疏勒、于闐並列，成為唐朝控制天山南北的四鎮之一。車師的問題沒有同時解決：交河一帶此後十餘年仍在唐與西突厥之間反覆易手，直到唐以強力把它固定下來，才算把這條線補齊。因此這場戰爭的結局是部分的：焉耆一地平定並被制度化，車師仍在拉鋸，而真正的對手西突厥仍然完整地在草原上。對唐太宗而言，這也驗證了他在貞觀十八年做的那個判斷——西域不能靠一次出兵守住，只能靠年年經營的據點、屯田與羈縻。從地圖上看，644年之後的天山南麓，屬於唐的節點是西州、焉耆、龜茲三處；以一場戰役的結果去衡量，它並不輝煌，但它是657年之後那一整套西域秩序的第一塊磚。
resultEn: The city of Yanqi was taken and the king's resistance ended. The remnants scattered towards the steppe and were chased by the horse as far as Western Turkic territory before the pursuit stopped; those who stayed in the basin were re-formed as jimi prefectures, watched over by a garrison and by military farms. The protectorate established a garrison at Yanqi, which, together with Kucha, Shule and Khotan later, became one of the four garrisons through which the Tang controlled the routes north and south of the Tian Shan. Cheshi was not settled at the same time: the Jiaohe area changed hands repeatedly between Tang and Western Turkic forces for more than a decade afterwards, and only when the Tang fixed it by force was the line completed. The outcome of this war was therefore partial. Yanqi alone was pacified and institutionalised, Cheshi was still being contested, and the real enemy, the Western Turkic khaganate, stood on the steppe still whole. For Taizong the war also confirmed the judgement he had made in 644: the Western Regions could not be held by one sortie; they could only be held by posts, military farms and jimi rule tended year after year. On the map, the Tang nodes south of the Tian Shan after 644 were three: Xizhou, Yanqi and Kucha. Judged as the outcome of a single war it was not brilliant, but it was the first brick of the whole western order that would follow 657.
